description: Land Acquisition - Elapatha, Elapaha D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The document provides detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions the Minister of Lands by name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of the notice, which is land acquisition - a core land/property matter falling under Type 4 classification.
